decision.rationale: Opt-in serial query-first public testkit now binds actual Runtime, MCP, Host and Provider facts through fresh Evidence and Claim/cache paths. Lab copies owner facts, preserves unknown usage/use, and rejects replay or unobserved cache origin. Scoped engineering proof, not default instrumentation, model-use or production-readiness claim.

reproduction.working_directory: respective Product package root; probe from monorepo root

positive_cases.description: Exact Evidence and Claim versions bind actual governed Runtime execution; plain/baseline/owner observations retain semantics.
Actual HTTP reuse retains original trace and exact version while binding a fresh current validation; governed supersession returns fresh version.
Host observation binds MCP/Context/Provider facts and preserves payload, response, budget and invocation count for fresh and cached requests.

negative_cases.description: Wrong-scope Evidence and Claims do not become exposed versions; scope/canonical change prevents old receipt reuse.
Missing/wrong Runtime execution or malformed current cache validation is rejected without guessed owner facts.
Prepared Context is not exposure before dispatch; lost response and unknown transport state retain unknown usage; unsupported stream/retry fails.

conformance_claims.covered_statement: For opt-in serial query-first tracing, the exact governed Context/version selection and dispatched exposure bind to actual Runtime/MCP/Host requests; validated cache reuse retains its original retrieval and uses the current authorized invocation. Exposure never implies model use.
limits: Not full protected Context or answer-lineage conformance.
No stream/concurrent observation or cross-process Host continuity claim.
Controlled Provider fixtures establish dispatch/native/usage plumbing, not model semantics or benefit.
Evidence and canonical Claim versions only; State/Note exports and Opportunity Ledger are outside this receipt.

identity_note: Claim/cache and Evidence probe commits differ only in two test files. Product executable tree/manifest and all Lab method source bytes are identical; each run retains its actual source commit. No previous artifact was relabeled.

development_failure.cause: Initial CURRENT-state comparison used varying read timestamps; source-only mypy gate was temporarily broadened to historical tests or a runner environment lacking public testkit packages.
development_failure.resolution: Fix the paired test clock, preserve CURRENT semantics, and use configured source gates plus actual pinned runner execution. Original failures remain documented; no Product permission/routing/time behavior changed.
